exposure: Closed reduction and casting for developmental dysplasia of the hip (DDH)
outcome: Avascular necrosis (AVN) of the femoral head
Patchy increased echogenicity in the femoral head on sonograms
cohort: Two individual cases of patients with developmental dysplasia of the hip who underwent closed reduction and casting.
finding: Patchy increased echogenicity in the unossified cartilage of the femoral head on sonograms obtained within 1.5 months of surgery should be considered a sign of evolving avascular necrosis following closed reduction for DDH.
followup_time: Sonograms obtained within 1.5 months of surgery
